_meta.description: MirageEndpoint's own envelope-wrapped events (heartbeat, health — Step 4). Raw Sysmon/Windows OS telemetry itself arrives via a SEPARATE path (Elastic Agent -> Fleet -> Elasticsearch's standard `logs-windows.sysmon_operational-*` integration data stream, ECS-mapped by Elastic's own integration package, not by this template) — see infra/elastic/README.md for how the two are correlated at query time by source_id/hostname. Appendix E names one conceptual stream; the two locked ingestion paths in §5's topology table produce it as two physical data streams under the hood. @timestamp (required by every ES data stream, and NOT configurable to a different field name in ES 8.15 — verified empirically) is populated from ingest_time by the mirage-set-timestamp ingest pipeline rather than added to the Step 1 envelope contract.
